item.description:
Taylor Swift "Red (Deluxe Version)"
Dolby Atmos Music



Taylor Swift's Red (Deluxe Version) is the expanded edition of her 2012 album Red, adding several bonus tracks like "The Moment I Knew," "Come Back...Be Here," "Girl at Home," demos, and acoustic versions, bringing the total to 22 songs and offering more depth to the iconic record with its mix of country and pop. It was released around the same time as the standard album and became popular for its extra content, available on platforms like Apple Music and through physical releases.
